badgeTitle: CAPTCHA risk {{score}}/100. Click for the reasons and fixes.
title: CAPTCHA score
subtitle: How likely sites are to challenge this profile, and what lowers it
leakTestTitle: Open the detailed leak check, including a live test of the running profile
fixAllTitle: Apply every fix that changes only this profile's settings or proxy
runningNote: This profile is open. Changes apply the next time it launches.
adviceOnly: Change this in the profile editor; a fix here would change the device sites already know.

result.warming: Warm-up started: the profile opens and browses a few popular sites. Follow it on the Automation page.
result.cookies: Third-party cookies are now allowed for every profile.

proxy.warn: No proxy: this profile uses your own connection, which every profile without a proxy shares.

proxyHealth.fail: Failed its last check, so pages time out or show errors.
proxyHealth.never: Never checked, so its health and blocklist status are unknown.

blocklist.pass: Not on any checked spam blocklist.
blocklist.warn: Not checked against spam blocklists yet.
blocklist.fail: The exit IP is on a spam blocklist. Google and Cloudflare challenge listed IPs far more often.

freeProxy.fail: A free public proxy. Most are flagged, so expect frequent CAPTCHAs.

ipType.warn: Datacenter IP{{isp}}. Sites challenge hosting-company IPs far more than home ones.

sharedProxy.msg_one: 1 other profile uses this proxy, so they share one IP and can be linked.
sharedProxy.msg_other: {{count}} other profiles use this proxy, so they share one IP and can be linked.

timezone.warn: Set by hand ({{zone}}), so it may not match the proxy.
timezone.fail: Uses this computer's timezone, which does not match the proxy's country.

language.warn: Language region {{region}} does not match the proxy's country {{country}}.
language.unverified: Set by hand ({{lang}}); the proxy's country is not known yet, so they cannot be compared.

geolocation.pass: Follows the proxy's IP, or is blocked.
geolocation.warn: Set by hand, so it may not match the proxy.

webrtc.pass: Mode {{mode}} keeps your real IP hidden.
webrtc.realNoProxy: Real with no proxy: sites already see this computer's IP, so WebRTC shows them nothing new.
webrtc.warn: WebRTC is disabled, which few real browsers do.
webrtc.fail: Set to Real, which shows your real IP behind the proxy.

thirdPartyCookies.warn: Blocked for every profile in Settings. reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha rely on them.

history.warn: Almost no cookies or history yet. Sites trust a profile that has been used.
history.warmed_one: Warmed up {{count}} time, so it has real browsing history and cookies.
history.warmed_other: Warmed up {{count}} times, so it has real browsing history and cookies.

device.warn: The graphics card (WebGL) may not fit this device or system.
device.fail: The graphics card (WebGL) does not fit this device or system.

osMismatch.warn: Claims {{claimed}} but runs on {{host}}; fonts and other details can show the real system.

prelaunch.title_one: Check this profile before it opens
prelaunch.subtitle: Sites can see these mismatches as soon as a profile opens.

issue.uaOs: The user agent says {{ua}}, but the profile is set to {{os}}.
issue.gpuOs: The graphics card (WebGL) does not fit {{os}}.

screen.mobile: A phone with a {{width}}x{{height}} screen; phone screens are narrow and upright.
screen.desktop: A computer with a {{width}}x{{height}} screen; computer screens are at least 1024x600.

issue.language: Language region {{region}} does not match the proxy's country {{country}}.
issue.timezone: The timezone comes from this computer, not from the proxy.
issue.webrtc: WebRTC is set to Real, which shows your real IP behind the proxy.
issue.proxyDead: The proxy failed its last check.
issue.socks4Dns: Uses the SOCKS4 proxy {{proxy}}. Chromium cannot send DNS lookups through SOCKS4, so every site would be looked up outside the proxy (a DNS leak), and the profile will not open. Open it in Firefox, or give it a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy.

prelaunch.blocking: (this profile will not open until you change it in the profile editor)
prelaunch.stopAsking: Don't check before launching again (turn it back on in Settings)

bulk.fixTitle: Apply the safe CAPTCHA fixes to the selected profiles: timezone, language, location, WebRTC, and a spare proxy when it lowers the risk
bulk.confirm_one: Fix CAPTCHA issues on this profile? Only settings and proxies that lower the risk are changed.
bulk.confirm_other: Fix CAPTCHA issues on {{count}} profiles? Only settings and proxies that lower the risk are changed.
bulk.done: Fixed {{changed}} of {{total}} profiles; {{swapped}} moved to a spare proxy.
bulk.noBetter: {{count}} could not get a better proxy.
